description: Local UI Server Function input (T44d; Task 44 design P2-1): check (GET) or save (POST) the three crawl limits of the target configuration a profile points to (crawl.maxPages, crawl.maxRuntimeMs, crawl.minNavigationIntervalMs). expectedTargetConfigDigest is the targetConfigDigestOf value of the file the screen read. The ranges are not bound here: the server checks them with the same rules as validateConfig and returns the problems by field.
